==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Johnson returned from space injured. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (Johnson returned in his normal form, so his power boost from the giant koi must have worn off.)
The original trident wielder arrives in the village and claims to rule the Cosmic Sea. (The original wielder of the Gold Trident is a flying, sparkling ruby (formerly golden), faceless humanoid wielding a glowing, magical, ruby (formerly golden) trident.) (I'll probably refer to the original trident wielder as the Ruby Wielder in the future.)
When they defeated the Were-Sharks long ago they became their ruler and just as evil as them. (Were-Sharks resemble humanoid sharks.) (This explains how the Were-Sharks had his Golden Trident when they invaded recently, and where he's been since he foiled their original invasion long ago.) (It is upsetting to see that Johnson's hero has now become his greatest villain and has taken back the trident that Johnson only recently claimed for himself.)
